ux_users_email_active.name: ux_users_email_active
ux_users_email_active.where: "users"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "users"."email" IS NOT NULL

ck_users_auth.name: ck_users_auth
ck_users_auth.value: "users"."password_hash" IS NOT NULL OR "users"."pin_hash" IS NOT NULL

ck_menu_items_price_consistency.name: ck_menu_items_price_consistency
ck_menu_items_price_consistency.value:
("menu_items"."price_type" = 'fixed' AND "menu_items"."price_fixed" IS NOT NULL AND "menu_items"."price_hot" IS NULL AND "menu_items"."price_iced" IS NULL)
        OR ("menu_items"."price_type" = 'variant' AND "menu_items"."price_fixed" IS NULL AND ("menu_items"."price_hot" IS NOT NULL OR "menu_items"."price_iced" IS NOT NULL))
        OR ("menu_items"."price_type" = 'open' AND "menu_items"."price_fixed" IS NULL AND "menu_items"."price_hot" IS NULL AND "menu_items"."price_iced" IS NULL)

ck_menu_items_price_nonneg.name: ck_menu_items_price_nonneg
ck_menu_items_price_nonneg.value:
("menu_items"."price_fixed" IS NULL OR "menu_items"."price_fixed" >= 0)
        AND ("menu_items"."price_hot" IS NULL OR "menu_items"."price_hot" >= 0)
        AND ("menu_items"."price_iced" IS NULL OR "menu_items"."price_iced" >= 0)

ck_shifts_close_consistency.name: ck_shifts_close_consistency
ck_shifts_close_consistency.value:
("shifts"."status" = 'closed' AND "shifts"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("shifts"."status" = 'open' AND "shifts"."closed_at" IS NULL)

ck_transactions_cash_fields.name: ck_transactions_cash_fields
ck_transactions_cash_fields.value:
("transactions"."payment_method" = 'cash' AND "transactions"."cash_received" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("transactions"."payment_method" <> 'cash' AND "transactions"."cash_received" IS NULL AND "transactions"."cash_change" IS NULL)

ux_recipes_menu_variant_set.name: ux_recipes_menu_variant_set
ux_recipes_menu_variant_set.where: "recipes"."menu_item_id" IS NOT NULL AND "recipes"."variant" IS NOT NULL

ux_recipes_menu_no_variant.name: ux_recipes_menu_no_variant
ux_recipes_menu_no_variant.where: "recipes"."menu_item_id" IS NOT NULL AND "recipes"."variant" IS NULL

ck_recipes_target_xor.name: ck_recipes_target_xor
ck_recipes_target_xor.value:
("recipes"."menu_item_id" IS NOT NULL AND "recipes"."ingredient_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("recipes"."menu_item_id" IS NULL AND "recipes"."ingredient_id" IS NOT NULL)

ck_approval_codes_consumed_pair.name: ck_approval_codes_consumed_pair
ck_approval_codes_consumed_pair.value: ("approval_codes"."consumed_at" IS NULL AND "approval_codes"."consumed_by_user_id" IS NULL) OR ("approval_codes"."consumed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "approval_codes"."consumed_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)

ck_approval_codes_revoked_pair.name: ck_approval_codes_revoked_pair
ck_approval_codes_revoked_pair.value: ("approval_codes"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "approval_codes"."revoked_by_user_id" IS NULL) OR ("approval_codes"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "approval_codes"."revoked_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)
